changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology
changeSet.comment: view_dn_stats keeps parent notes that have no child note
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW view_dn_stats AS SELECT dn.discrepancy_note_id, CASE WHEN dn.resolution_status_id = 1 OR dn.resolution_status_id = 2 OR dn.resolution_status_id = 3 THEN DATE_PART('day', current_timestamp - COALESCE(totals.date_updated, dn.date_created)) ELSE NULL::integer END AS days, CASE WHEN dn.resolution_status_id = 1 OR dn.resolution_status_id = 2 OR dn.resolution_status_id = 3 THEN DATE_PART('day', current_timestamp - dn.date_created) WHEN dn.resolution_status_id = 4 THEN DATE_PART('day', COALESCE(totals.date_updated, dn.date_created) - dn.date_created) ELSE NULL::integer END AS age, COALESCE(totals.total_notes, 1) AS total_notes, dn.date_created, COALESCE(totals.date_updated, dn.date_created) AS date_updated FROM discrepancy_note dn LEFT JOIN (SELECT dn1.parent_dn_id, max(dn1.date_created) AS date_updated, count(dn1.discrepancy_note_id) AS total_notes FROM discrepancy_note dn1 GROUP BY dn1.parent_dn_id) totals ON dn.discrepancy_note_id = totals.parent_dn_id WHERE dn.parent_dn_id IS NULL OR dn.parent_dn_id = 0;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW view_dn_stats AS SELECT dn.discrepancy_note_id, CASE WHEN dn.resolution_status_id = 1 OR dn.resolution_status_id = 2 OR dn.resolution_status_id = 3 THEN DATE_PART('day', current_timestamp - totals.date_updated) ELSE NULL::integer END AS days, CASE WHEN dn.resolution_status_id = 1 OR dn.resolution_status_id = 2 OR dn.resolution_status_id = 3 THEN DATE_PART('day', current_timestamp - dn.date_created) WHEN dn.resolution_status_id = 4 THEN DATE_PART('day', totals.date_updated - dn.date_created) ELSE NULL::integer END AS age, totals.total_notes, dn.date_created, totals.date_updated FROM discrepancy_note dn, (SELECT dn1.parent_dn_id, max(dn1.date_created) AS date_updated, count(dn1.discrepancy_note_id) AS total_notes FROM discrepancy_note dn1 GROUP BY dn1.parent_dn_id) totals WHERE (dn.parent_dn_id IS NULL OR dn.parent_dn_id = 0) AND dn.discrepancy_note_id = totals.parent_dn_id;
